raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_customers is an SCD2-style history table with 30 customers duplicated (one is_current=False row and one is_current=True row). gold_region_daily joins silver_transactions to all customer rows, so each transaction for those 30 customers is counted twice, inflating 4558 to 5251. Each customer has exactly one current row, so filtering to is_current=True removes the fan-out without dropping any customer, and gives the same region as a point-in-time join for 2026 transactions.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"gold_region_daily": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE gold_region_daily AS SELECT t.txn_date, c.region, count(*) AS n_txn, sum(t.amount) AS total FROM silver_transactions t JOIN (SELECT customer_id, upper(region) AS region FROM raw_customers WHERE is_current) c USING (customer_id) GROUP BY t.txn_date, c.region;"}}
